name: EMPOWER Rivers Community Grant
summary: Grants of up to £20,000 to community groups and small charities in London for small-scale, volunteer-led river restoration, such as berms, wood deflectors and invasive species control, plus equipment for river maintenance and water monitoring.

calls.label: Final round launching December 2026
calls.note: The page says the final round launches in December 2026 and applications will be due in March 2027; no firm dates are stated.

status.quote: The EMPOWER Rivers Community Grant will be launching again in December 2026 for one final round. The deadline for applications will be in March 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Thames21 can support small-scale river restoration projects led by community groups or small charities in London.
